title: Design Trending / Top-K
tagline: A billion events a day, whiteboarded live
interviewPrompt: For today's Software Engineer interview, find the top 10 trending hashtags in real time.

beats.interviewer: For today's Software Engineer interview, find the top 10 trending hashtags out of a billion events a day, in real time.
beats.interviewee: Naive complete system: stream events into a big count map, sort, take the top 10. End to end, exact, simple.
beats.show: Naive complete: Stream → Count Map → Sort → Top 10.

beats.interviewee: Same full path under pressure: a billion distinct keys will not fit in memory, and sorting on every read is dead on arrival.
beats.show: Same complete naive path. Memory + sort blow up.

beats.interviewer: So what are you willing to give up?
beats.interviewee: Exactness. I still need a complete system that returns a top 10, approximately, right now.
beats.show: Requirement stays: complete Top-10 path, allow approximate.

beats.interviewee: Rework the middle: Count-Min Sketch estimates frequency in kilobytes, min-heap holds current top K. Stream → sketch → heap → Top 10. Constant memory, constant update.
beats.show: Rework complete: Stream → Sketch → Heap → Top 10.

beats.interviewer: And if the business demanded exact counts?
beats.interviewee: Alternate complete path: shard by hashtag, merge per-shard heaps. Sketch path still there as the cheap approximate option.
beats.show: Two complete systems: sketch approx vs shard+merge exact.
